_comment: Pre-registered m2 PILOT cell on RWKV7-G1k-13.3B (jobs/rwkv7 stage B; train/run_cell.py). Learning-signal + fit + fork-numerics pilot, not a factorial cell: no Index number is claimed from it. LoRA rank 64 (not the m2 default 256) keeps T=2048, K<=16 at ~59 GB on the train.estimate model (rank 256: ~72 GB, too close to the 76 GB stop). Rows with K > max_k are dropped (banking77/clinc150 have 77/150 options; the cache fork stores one recurrent state per option).
head: fork

attack_clean.rule: attack_guard/v2: concatenated record text + base64 decodes; 6-gram or exact (4-5 word) fragment, whole-template wildcard (placeholder = 1..30 words, >= 4 fixed words), or fuzzy >= 0.5 of fixed word 3-grams (>= 3); NFKC, Cf removed, Cyrillic+Greek homoglyphs folded, casefold
attack_clean.filter: drop every record with any attack_guard hit (train.attack_guard.record_hits)
